In Re:- Chandan Santra vs Re: An Application For Bail Under ...
on 10 May, 2016
Author: Ashim Kumar Roy
Bench: Ashim Kumar Roy
 1
20 10.5.2016
p.d. C.R.M. No. 3331 of 2016
 In re:- Chandan Santra

entities.text: Chandan Santra vs Re: An Application For Bail
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: -And- Re: An application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. affirmed on 20.4.2016 in connection with Moyna Police Station Case No.227/2015 dated 28.9.2015 under Sections 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, read with West Bengal Act 42 of 1973 and Sections 3/304/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 46AA of the Bengal Excise Act 1909 and Section 16(3) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954.
Mr. Mazhar Hossain Chowdhury ... For the petitioner.
Mr. Manjit Singh, P.P., Mr. Partha Pratim Das .... For the State.
Heard the learned Advocates appearing on behalf of the parties.

The petitioner is in custody for more than 220 days and already investigation is over and although charge sheet has been submitted against 9 accused persons but none of the chargesheeted accuseds are on bail.
It is the case of the prosecution that by consuming poisonous I.D. liquor, about 23 persons died and quite a large number of persons became seriously ill.

We have been informed by the learned Public Prosecutor that after the accuseds' prayer for discharge under Section 227 Cr.P.C. was turned down, they took adjournment till May 24, 20015, on the ground of moving this Hon'ble Court against such order and therefore, no charge could be framed.
We have gone through the case diary.

Having regard to the nature and seriousness of the allegation and the gravity of the offence, in our In Re:- Chandan Santra vs Re: An Application For Bail Under ... on 10 May, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30616731/
1 opinion, this is not a fit case for bail.

entities.text: Chandan Santra vs Re: An Application For Bail Under
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the application for bail stands rejected.
(Ashim Kumar Roy, J.) (Malay Marut Banerjee, J.)
